def _path_to_elements(path, root_element=DEFAULT_FIRST_ELEMENT):
    elements = []
    if not path or path == 'root':
        return elements
    
    i = 0
    inside = None
    current_elem = ''
    
    while i < len(path):
        char = path[i]
        
        if char == '[':
            if current_elem and current_elem != 'root':
                _add_to_elements(elements, current_elem, inside)
                current_elem = ''
            inside = '['
            i += 1
            current_elem = ''

                current_elem += path[i]
                i += 1
            _add_to_elements(elements, current_elem, inside)
            current_elem = ''

                _add_to_elements(elements, current_elem, inside)
            current_elem = ''
            inside = '.'
            i += 1
            while i < len(path) and path[i] not in {'[', '.'}:
                current_elem += path[i]
                i += 1
            if current_elem:
                _add_to_elements(elements, current_elem, inside)

        else:

    return elements


def parse_path(path, root_element=DEFAULT_FIRST_ELEMENT, include_actions=False):
